compatibility: additive 2015 sex totals and exact clan-summary layer for all 31 core surnames

conventions.source_reference: Prefer source_id values registered in data/meta/sources.csv for new structured datasets.
conventions.method_reference: Use method_id for school- or author-dependent naming and myeongri rules.
conventions.legal_hanja: Candidate search data and final legal verification are separate layers.
conventions.stroke_counts: Unicode technical strokes and naming-school stroke counts are separate fields.
conventions.null_policy: Unknown values remain null/empty; do not infer unsupported facts.
conventions.surname_role: Treat surname Hanja, given-name Hanja, bongwan, census statistics, and method-specific stroke values as separate fields.
conventions.surname_semantics: Do not score a surname dictionary gloss as given-name semantic quality unless a selected method explicitly requires it.
conventions.surname_pronunciation: Store phonological structure separately from subjective euphony; do not treat repetition notices as hard failures.
conventions.clan_history: Store clan-history claims with evidence_level and caveat; census identity and genealogical tradition are separate.
conventions.surname_strokes: A dictionary/technical stroke count is not a default numerology count; method_id is required for naming-school calculations.
conventions.common_surname_coverage: Core surname data covers 2015 census ranks 1-31; top30-excluding-xu-2015.csv records the 30 newly added surnames because 徐(rank 13) was already present.
conventions.representative_clans: representative-clans-2015.csv is partial and must never be interpreted as a complete clan list.
conventions.hangul_hanja_disambiguation: Same Hangul surname with different Hanja must remain separate surname_id records.
conventions.genealogy_claim_roles: Keep founder, progenitor, middle ancestor, branch founder, historical clan reference, genealogy documentation, myth and legend as distinct claim types.
conventions.genealogy_conflicts: Never auto-resolve conflicting founder or origin claims; preserve source_ids, evidence_level and caveat.
conventions.hangnyeol: Do not infer or generate generation names unless a verified clan-specific source is registered.
conventions.clan_summary: Use up to seven major bongwan rows plus a computed remainder that closes exactly to the surname total; never label the computed remainder as the source table's 기타.
conventions.full_clan_raw: KOSIS DT_1IN15SD all-5plus bongwan raw coverage is distinct from the app summary layer.
